tasks.short: Maintain supply inventories and client service records

steps.what: Count supplies and capture receipts, usage, waste and stock discrepancies
Maintain supply inventories by reconciling stock movements and balances
Record client services, products used and relevant client preferences

tasks.design: Use the existing {OTHER} salon records application for stock arithmetic and linked client cards. Keep physical counts and usage capture intact, reuse verified appointment and checkout facts, and have the technician enter and check the service-specific notes.
tasks.previous_blocker: Stock totals and client history are copied across paper records after observations and checkout.
tasks.enabler_now: Native client cards and inventory fields can reuse entered facts without inferring product consumption or client health.
tasks.still_hard: Partial containers, waste, unusual product use and sensitive notes need accurate human capture.
tasks.human_edge: The technician knows what was actually used and what matters for the next service.
tasks.altitude: Maintain a dependable history and inventory with less copying, retaining responsibility for actual use.

reach.task: Resolve stock differences and define necessary client-record fields
reach.learn: Product units and minimal, purpose-specific recording

evidence.claim: Salonized client cards hold treatment and purchase history, appointment notes and intake forms.
Stock arithmetic and the proposed time saving are E1 design assumptions; the cited client-card capability does not establish measured inventory savings.
Health-related notes require a valid exception for processing special-category data; unnecessary health information should not be collected.

assumptions: Boundary covers physical stock verification, inventory maintenance and recording completed client services; actual treatment, booking and taking payment are excluded.

In s1 the technician produces item ID, count date, unit, opening count, receipt quantity, observed consumption, waste and correction reason; all physical checks and first capture retain 40 hours. No standard recipe is assumed to predict actual product use.

s2's eight remaining hours cover balance checks and unresolved differences. Missing movement facts are entered manually from observations; no automatic reordering or inferred discrepancy code is introduced.

The technician produces completed service facts and preferences in s3; its 20 remaining hours include note capture, verification and correction. Existing appointment and checkout records provide client ID, date, service and paid amount; incomplete records are completed manually. The saving covers re-entry only.
Test native client cards and inventory configuration first. Existing single-entry practice earns no saving; if inventory is unsupported, keep that part manual rather than assume a free integration.
unknowns: Inventory capability and current duplicate entry
Required client fields, lawful basis and access restrictions
research_questions: Can a single service record preserve needed information without collecting unnecessary health data?
How much inventory effort remains after actual usage and waste capture?

already_counted.description: Physical stock checks and first capture

incremental.description: Maintain stock units, client fields and permissions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=40+8+20=68; gross 32%, less 4 upkeep gives net 28%. Low 0 with existing single entry, unsupported inventory or heavy missing-data correction.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Schedule appointments and accept client payments

steps.what: Clarify client appointment request, service choice and practical requirements
Schedule client appointments and confirm the agreed service, time and price
Accept payments and resolve cash, card or amount discrepancies

tasks.design: Configure the native agenda and confirmation fields in the {OTHER} salon booking system, using {CALENDAR} availability. The technician checks the final booking before confirming it and retains the request conversation and all payment handling.
tasks.previous_blocker: Appointment details are repeatedly typed and compared with staff calendars.
tasks.enabler_now: Native booking software can show conflicts and reuse captured request details without replacing the conversation.
tasks.still_hard: Service ambiguity, timing exceptions and payment disputes need direct help.
tasks.human_edge: The technician clarifies what the client wants and resolves exceptions respectfully.
tasks.altitude: Reduce booking re-entry while retaining client contact and payment responsibility.

reach.task: Maintain realistic service durations and booking restrictions
reach.learn: Calendar constraints and when staff must clarify a service

evidence.claim: Salonized provides an online agenda, booking, reminders and payment features.
This design's assisted-booking saving is E1; no measured case saving is established in the digest.

assumptions: Boundary covers request clarification, booking confirmation and accepting payment; completed treatment and separate client-history maintenance are outside it.

The technician produces client ID and permitted contact details, service selection, requested time, staff preference and access needs in s1 with all 30 hours retained. No new customer self-service work is required.

The salon manager already maintains service duration, price and staff calendar in normal planning. s2's 20 hours include checking those facts, resolving missing fields and approving each exact client/service/staff/time/price confirmation before sending; changes void a1.
Use the native agenda first; if already used there is no incremental booking saving. No automatic refund, card debit or new payment linkage is assumed; s3 retains all payment labour.
unknowns: Accuracy of service duration and calendar data
research_questions: Does an assisted native booking reduce re-entry after request and confirmation checks?

already_counted.description: Booking checks, exceptions and positive confirmation approval

incremental.description: Maintain confirmation fields and calendar access checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact final booking with client, permitted contact channel, service, staff, date/time, price and confirmation text; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+20+30=80; gross 20%, less 3 upkeep gives net 17%. Low 0 where native booking already exists or service exceptions use the saving. Payment time is unchanged.

tasks.short: Assess hand condition and provide hands-on care

steps.what: Assess the condition of clients' hands and agree appropriate service limits
Remove dead skin and massage hands while checking comfort and response

tasks.design: Retain direct assessment and hand care, using established service guidance in {DOCS}. No model interprets photographs or authorizes a treatment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Hand condition, skin response and comfort must be observed directly.
tasks.enabler_now: No software-only change removes this physical care or the assessment it needs.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain conditions and adverse responses require the technician to stop, defer or refer within local competence.
tasks.human_edge: The technician combines observation, touch and client feedback while working.
tasks.altitude: Hands-on care and its limits remain unchanged.

reach.task: Confirm service limits and referral procedure for concerning hand conditions
reach.learn: Distinguish cosmetic assessment from medical diagnosis

evidence.claim: Physical assessment and hand care remain human in this task-specific assessment.

assumptions: Boundary is direct assessment, consent conversation and hand care, excluding separate service-record entry.
The technician gathers observations and client responses in s1 and s2 with all time counted. No ready structured suitability decision is assumed.
Only locally permitted cosmetic services are included; the occupational statement grants no medical authority.
Existing guidance is unchanged and no new process is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Local service limits and referral procedure
research_questions: Which observations require deferral under the salon's current service guidance?

already_counted.description: Physical care and client response checks

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=30+70=100; no assessment or physical care time is removed. Gross and net zero with no upkeep.

tasks.short: Advise clients on nail care, products and colors

steps.what: Advise clients on nail care and use of products and colors

tasks.design: Keep advice with the technician, supported by product instructions in {DOCS} and physical color samples. No new generated advice or product-selection model is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Useful advice depends on the client's condition, preferences and understanding.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing references assist the conversation but establish no new labour saving.
tasks.still_hard: Product compatibility and unusual nail conditions require care within cosmetic service limits.
tasks.human_edge: The technician explains choices clearly and checks that the client understands practical care.
tasks.altitude: Client advice and product discussions remain human.

reach.task: Confirm product-use guidance and escalation for uncertain conditions
reach.learn: Read current manufacturer instructions and avoid unsupported health claims

evidence.claim: Tailored nail-care advice remains a direct human conversation in this task assessment.

assumptions: Boundary is advice and choice, not treatment, payment or separate client-record maintenance.
The technician elicits preferences and observes relevant conditions within s1, retaining all time. No structured personal profile or medical diagnosis is assumed.
Use existing manufacturer guidance as a reference; no new catalogue maintenance is transferred to another role.
There is no new tool or process, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Common product questions and current references
research_questions: Is repeated product-fact retrieval a measurable separate burden within actual consultations?

already_counted.description: Preference gathering, explanation and choice discussion

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; no advisory conversation time is removed. Gross and net zero, upkeep zero.
